text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- 30 Syrian medical firms show products at Baghdad International Fair.
- President Saddam Hussein signs law allowing non-Iraqis Arabs to acquire Iraqi nationality within three months.
- President chairs cabinet meeting, stresses role of judges, lawyers and courts in preserving Iraqi laws.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
